dedupe_keys.name: dataset manuscript innovative flow through photocatalytic reactor for sustainable removal of water disinfection by products

description: The source identifies data for an innovative flow-through photocatalytic reactor for removing water-disinfection byproducts. Declared files include single-DBP and mixture photocatalytic-activity spreadsheets, chloride measurements, an HR-ICP-MS workbook, Raman spectra for ceramic matrices and PCF, and three SEM images. File names establish those components, but do not establish units, detection limits, treatment efficiency or the identity of every chemical species. The related photocatalytic treatment datasets concern separate deposits whose experimental overlap remains unverified. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The deposit lists publicly accessible files under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
